issues.what: granule texture is pulled into parallel horizontal bands and meets the cells in a sawtooth edge; the same shear is in image-06.png crop E
issues.fix: stop stretching the granule map into the penumbra and blend the filaments into the cells

issues.where: near terrain, crops S through W
issues.what: cells read as packed scales with the same radial fiber on every crown and hard carved lanes; the same surface fills image-01.png, image-05.png, and image-08.png
issues.fix: drop the repeated radial grain and let the cell tops vary in emission instead of a silky fiber

issues.what: the horizon is a hard line with a regular fringe of upright spikes; the same fringe runs along image-05.png
issues.fix: vary the spike height and spacing and soften the limb so the glow does not sit on a hard line

issues.what: the umbra is a flat black void and the spokes run straight into it; image-05.png has the same empty core
issues.fix: give the core a soft floor and small bright dots so the spokes do not pinch into a hole

issues.what: the brighter stars are small round discs; the fainter ones stay pinpoints, and the sky crops in image-03.png hold up
issues.fix: keep the bright stars to a tight point with a short falloff

issues.where: crops A and F, center of the terrain view around the dark sunspot
issues.what: Long, nearly parallel filaments stretch into a pinched oval with a nearly featureless black center. The stretched collar stops abruptly against the surrounding granules.
issues.fix: Build the penumbra from shorter, irregular filaments that vary in width and direction and intermix with the adjacent granules. Preserve faint structure in the dark core.

issues.where: crops S through W, foreground granules
issues.what: The smooth domes share the same brushed streaks, dark outlines and bright gold highlights. They read as polished, molded pebbles rather than granular plasma.
issues.fix: Break up the shared dome profile and outlines, reduce the specular look, and vary cell shape, scale and fine emissive texture.

issues.where: crops T and U, lower solar disk
issues.what: Most bright granules smear into short parallel streaks, leaving much less resolved detail than on the upper disk. The blur spans large contiguous areas.
issues.fix: Re-render the disk detail with less directional filtering and preserve distinct fine granules through the lower disk and into the foreshortened limb.

issues.where: crops B, E and F, corona along the upper and right limbs
issues.what: Broad, soft gray-white spokes radiate off a narrow bright rim at similar widths, making the corona look like a separate radial-blur layer.
issues.fix: Replace the uniform spokes and bright rim with irregular fine streamers, varying their angles, widths and density, and blend their bases into the limb.

issues.where: crops S and V, lower-left and lower-right prominences
issues.what: The broader red-orange loops look like flat, soft-edged ribbons, and some short bright segments end in blunt, rectangular tips.
issues.fix: Split the broad ribbons into thinner translucent strands and taper their ends.

issues.where: crops N, Q and R, limb above the far terrain
issues.what: Short luminous spikes repeat at similar angles and heights, giving the limb a comb-like fringe.
issues.fix: Vary the height, spacing and tilt of the spikes and leave occasional quiet gaps in the fringe.

issues.where: crops B, C, D, and E (coronal rays around the limb)
issues.what: several coronal rays appear as overly straight, uniform radial streaks with slight aliasing against the starfield
issues.fix: soften the sharpest ray edges and introduce subtle curvature and feathering along the outer coronal streamers

issues.where: crops C and D (upper-right and lower-left solar prominences)
issues.what: parts of the red plasma loops have slightly hard, ribbon-like cutout edges against the bright inner corona
issues.fix: blend the outer boundaries of the prominence filaments more gradually into the surrounding coronal glow
